pages.title: Food Pouch
pages.text: The Food Pouch is a portable container that slows food spoilage. Food stored inside ages at $(bold)half the normal speed$() — so a 4-day food lasts 8 days instead. It requires no power and fits in your inventory.

pages.title: Using the Pouch
pages.text: Right-click the Food Pouch to open it. It holds 9 food items. Great for long adventures where you can't keep a fridge nearby. The pouch works as long as you're carrying it — it checks once per day.
A great companion for any explorer.
